mn38:4.2: “Sir, a mendicant named Sāti, the fisherman’s son, has given rise to the following harmful misconception:
mn38:4.3: ‘As I understand the Buddha’s teaching, it is this very same consciousness that roams and transmigrates, not another.’
mn38:4.4: We heard the rumour, sir, that a mendicant named Sāti, the fisherman’s son, had given rise to the following harmful misconception:
mn38:4.5: ‘As I understand the Buddha’s teaching, it is this very same consciousness that roams and transmigrates, not another.’
mn38:4.6: Then, sir, we went up to Sāti and said to him,
mn38:4.7: ‘Is it really true, Reverend Sāti, that you have such a harmful misconception:
mn38:4.8: “As I understand the Buddha’s teaching, it is this very same consciousness that roams and transmigrates, not another”?’
mn38:4.9: When we said this, sir, Sāti said to us,
mn38:4.10: ‘Indeed, reverends. As I understand the Buddha’s teaching, it is this very same consciousness that roams and transmigrates, not another.’
mn38:4.11: Then, sir, wishing to dissuade Sāti from his view, we pursued, pressed, and grilled him,
mn38:4.12: ‘Don’t say that, Sāti! Don’t misrepresent the Buddha, for misrepresentation of the Buddha is not good. And the Buddha would not say that.
mn38:4.13: In many ways the Buddha has said that consciousness is dependently originated, that without a cause, consciousness does not come to be.’
mn38:4.14: But even though we pressed him in this way, sir, Sāti obstinately stuck to his misconception and insisted on it:
mn38:4.15: ‘Indeed, reverends. As I understand the Buddha’s teaching, it is this very same consciousness that roams and transmigrates, not another.’
mn38:4.16: Since we were unable to dissuade Sāti from his view, sir, we are reporting this matter to the Buddha.”
mn38:8.16: Consciousness that arises dependent on the eye and sights is reckoned as eye consciousness.
mn38:8.17: Consciousness that arises dependent on the ear and sounds is reckoned as ear consciousness.
mn38:8.18: Consciousness that arises dependent on the nose and smells is reckoned as nose consciousness.
mn38:8.19: Consciousness that arises dependent on the tongue and tastes is reckoned as tongue consciousness.
mn38:8.20: Consciousness that arises dependent on the body and touches is reckoned as body consciousness.
mn38:8.21: Consciousness that arises dependent on the mind and ideas is reckoned as mind consciousness.
